display_name: Regulation Crowdfunding as one wiki page presents it — eligibility, limits, disclosure, intermediaries, advertising, reporting, resale
versions_encoded: Law as in force on 2026-07-23, with a rule-version axis back to commencement: 16 May 2016, 12 April 2017, 15 March 2021 and 20 September 2022 (regcf.l4:114-128). Every constant in a dateable function's read set is dated over the same window, so the module answers under `EVAL UNDER RULES EFFECTIVE AT` for any rule date from commencement.
scope: The eight requirement groups of 17 CFR Part 227 that one external wiki page presents, in its order, and no more (regcf.l4:14-26): issuer eligibility, the offering limit, investor limits, disclosure, intermediary obligations, advertising, ongoing reporting and resale. NOT a full formalisation of Part 227 — the funding-portal regime (Rules 400-404), the bad-actor detail (Rule 503) and most of the Rule 201 itemisation are out of scope and say so at regcf.l4:28-31. regcf.l4 carries no @export; regcf-wizard.l4 is the founder/investor façade that does. Interpretive forks are in registers/fork-register.json. 112 assertions (regcf.l4 83, regcf-wizard.l4 29), none failing, with four goldens per module.

not_reviewed.note: No HG1 grant or waiver was found for this encoding in legalese/l4-ide, where it was written. Treat it as unreviewed: no domain expert has read it against Part 227 section by section and signed.
